description:
# EndFix

Turn any world into The End or Nether - or convert it back. Made for Nukkit MOT.

**EN:** Want to rebuild a world as The End/Nether (or fix a broken converted one)? This plugin helps.  
**UK:** Хочеш переробити світ під Край/Ад (або полагодити зламану конвертацію)? Цей плагін допоможе.  
**RU:** Хочешь переделать мир под Край/Ад (или починить сломанную конвертацию)? Этот плагин поможет.

Author: **YehrLB**

## Requirements

- Java 17+
- Nukkit MOT

## Build

```bash
mvn -DskipTests package
```

Jar: `target/EndFix-1.1.0.jar`  
(put `lib/Nukkit-MOT-SNAPSHOT.jar` locally for compile - not in the repo)

## Quick start

1. Drop jar into `plugins/`
2. Backup the world folder first
3. `/endfixworld my_world` - make it The End  
   `/netherfixworld my_world` - make it Nether  
   `/worldfix my_world` - convert back to overworld  
   `/endbiome 128` - fix End biomes around spawn
4. Optional: `quick` = only `level.dat` (faster, may need full run later)

## Config

`plugins/EndFix/config.yml`

```yaml
language: en   # en | uk | ru
portal:
  end-worlds: [the_end, world_the_end]
  overworld-worlds: [world]
```

Languages: `plugins/EndFix/lang/`  
In-game: `/endfix lang uk`

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/endfix` | Help |
| `/endfix lang <en\|uk\|ru>` | Language |
| `/endfixworld [world] [quick]` | World → The End |
| `/netherfixworld [world] [quick]` | World → Nether |
| `/worldfix <world> [quick]` | Back to overworld |
| `/endbiome <radius> [force] [debug]` | Fix End biomes |

## License

See [LICENSE](https://github.com/YehrLB/DimensionsReconstructe/blob/main/LICENSE) (EN / UK / RU).
